twoFactor.title: Two-factor code
twoFactor.hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryHint: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each works once.
twoFactor.useCode: Use a code from the app

chooseTenant.title: Choose an organization
chooseTenant.hint: You belong to several. Which one do you want to work in?

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.hint: We'll email you a link to choose a new password.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.signUp: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your address, then sign in here.
checkEmail.forgot: If an account exists for {{email}}, we sent it a link to choose a new password. It opens in your browser; then sign in here.

errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.captcha: This server asks for a bot check that the app can't show yet. Ask its administrator, or sign in on the web.
errors.offline: You're offline. Changes are sent when you're back.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to answer. Try again.

language.title: Language
language.restart: Close and reopen the app to switch the layout direction.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.hint: Where your account is signed in: browsers and apps.
sessions.everywhereBody: Every browser and app signed in to your account, this one included, will be signed out.

notificationSettings.title: Notifications
notificationSettings.hint: In the app you always get every notification. Choose what also comes by email, and how often.
notificationSettings.mandatory: Required: email can be bundled, not switched off.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.on: Push and text messages wait from {{start}} to {{end}} ({{timezone}}), except urgent ones.
quietHours.off: Off: push and text messages arrive at any time.

notes.title: Title
notes.deleteBody: "{{title}}" is moved to the deleted notes; an administrator can restore it.
notes.conflict: Someone else changed this note since you opened it. Load their version, then make your change again.
